execution_owner: Main; all commands below are unexecuted at implementation handoff
bounded_repair: flock_search accepts at most four explicit --tip FULL_COMMIT inputs already present locally, inspects at most 128 commits, and --prepare FULL_COMMIT only stages source-supported same-commit config+registry+Keccak candidates (or the exact historical failure control). Prepared source remains under research/r2/conditional/work; it emits but never executes the control command. No network fetch or derivation of unreviewed m21 presets.
explicit_gate_input: gates.py --evidence PATH accepts {branch: {prerequisite: {satisfied: true|false|null, artifact: repository-relative research file, sha256: exact file digest, scope: nonempty claim scope}}}. Names are emitted in the default matrix. Missing facts are null and never an architecture failure.
hardware_execution: hardware.py emits portable generic-CPU build plus process-cold/warm commands for the real local machine. --x86-binary accepts an existing public executable; x86 commands exist only for compatible native execution or Linux static ELF plus qemu-x86_64, with emulation explicitly labeled. A qemu-system executable without a guest is not an available machine. No SSH hosts/private config discovery.
l2_scope: Exact frozen v03-fixed-01 proof A/B and ABI bytes, pinned existing public-key signer and fee functions. Nonces 7 and 8, zero value, fixed public sink. Signatures are computed locally only and only hashes/sizes retained. No RPC or broadcast interface. Concatenated A/B is a transport-only control, never a combined ABI verifier path.
approval_boundary: No production/testnet/network signing, no notes in outer witness, no fake complete verifier, no architecture rejection from a missing measurement. Final benchmark and local-node execution remains Main-owned.
